tools.name: import_status
tools.description: State of the data imports: for each scheduled task, its last run, whether it succeeded and the last successful run (UTC).

tools.name: data_quality
tools.description: Known gaps in the data, per chamber: date of the latest vote, incomplete roll calls, votes without a result, members in office compared with seats, overlapping terms, members without a group.

tools.name: list_types
tools.description: Lists the available document types (parliamentary vote, popular vote, law, bill, petition, member), their filters, the published countries and chambers, and the themes.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches documents of one type, most recent first (members: alphabetical order; petitions can be sorted by signatures). Titles are in the language of the source: search with words of that language.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Full record of a document found with search.

tools.name: vote_positions
tools.description: For a parliamentary vote: breakdown by political group and the position of each member (for, against, abstention, non_voting, absent).

tools.name: member_history
tools.description: History of the recorded votes held during a member's terms (absences included, incomplete roll calls excluded).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
